principle: Spend the strongest scarce model capacity only where additional reasoning depth can change a decisive gate. Throughput may degrade when allowance is constrained; evidence standards may not.

no_hidden_spend.rule: Exhaustion of included allowance causes fallback to an included available capability or queues the task; it never authorizes paid usage.

use_cases: deep Red Team on serious survivor
methodology contradiction with large downstream consequence
Director scheduling when no Tier A need exists
very high-volume low-ambiguity triage only when local deterministic code is insufficient
format/structure normalization that is independently validated
TIER_D_FAST.rule: Prefer local exact code over a model for deterministic hash, dedupe, parsing, schema and arithmetic tasks.

escalation: Start at the cheapest included capability consistent with the task's ambiguity and consequence.
Escalate only when a documented uncertainty remains that stronger reasoning can plausibly resolve.
Promotion-relevant conclusions require the configured high-reasoning gate even if discovery occurred on a faster tier.
Record model/capability tier and reasoning setting in each worker artifact for benchmark analysis.
Model agreement across tiers is not independent evidence when upstream data and reasoning path are shared.
usage_protection: Primary and Recon discovery must retain enough allowance to run during ACTIVE-HOUR even if a deep candidate is consuming Tier A/B capacity.
WAITING_FOR_DATA candidates receive no repeated deep-model analysis without new evidence.
No hourly report spends Tier A capacity merely to restate unchanged status.
If Tier A capacity is unavailable, serious reproduction/adjudication may remain queued rather than silently lowering its evidence standard.
